name: spaceship-x26-prms
description: Spaceship X26 Passenger Resource Management System (PRMS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @prms/api" "npm run dev -w @prms/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prms/web && npm run build -w @prms/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
